text:
maya: quick sync - we need a compact, testable rollout plan for the new staged preflight (feature-flag + canary). goal: safe ramp with minimal customer impact and clear rollback triggers.

alex: propose 3 windows: smoke (internal, <2h), alpha tenants (10% users, 48h), regional GA (gradual 25/50/75/100). add an A/B fold inside alpha for quality checks.

chen: what are the gating signals? list please.

maya: suggested gates: p95 latency, p99 latency, 5xx rate, token-cost delta, intent-accuracy delta, hallucination-rate delta.

deniz: concrete thresholds: default p95 < 350ms, p99 < 1.2s, 5xx < 0.5%, cost delta < +20%, intent-acc drop < 1.0%, hallucination +0.5 points. low-latency tenants get p95=300ms.

priya: fallback order idea: (1) switch to compact-quantized model, (2) limit concurrency by 30%, (3) route new sessions away from affected region, (4) full rollback. prefer model-switch first to avoid user-visible session breaks.

alex: agree. will encode policy like: 

```yaml
rollout:
  windows: [smoke, alpha, regional-ga]
  gates: {p95_ms:350, p99_ms:1200, error_pct:0.5}
  fallback: [model-compact-v3, throttle-30pct, region-redirect, rollback-to-stable]
```
deploy-bot: rollout-started id=staged-preflight-2026-03-21 ts=1798887801

chen: add eval harness hook: run canary promptset every 30m during alpha with 50-sample human spot-check if hallucination delta > 0.3.

deniz: add network check for region-redirect; stateful flows might break. i'll verify constraints.

maya: ops checklist: alerts (p99,error), dashboards (token-cost, model-splits), traces @10% sampling, slack bridge for alpha tenants, and a preflight chaos test (simulate 15-20% tail latency).

alex: A/B in alpha: 10% variant / 90% control, continuous eval; if any gate breaches then auto-fallback.

priya: i'll draft support runbook and customer comms template for alpha tenants.

maya: owners: gates = deniz+maria, promptset = chen, routing/header = alex, support runbook = priya. scheduling a 20-min preflight tomorrow.

alex: added X-Redwood-Rollout header for telemetry splits.

maya: thanks everyone. keeping the rollout config PR small so we can iterate. :thumbsup:
